claims.statement: Validates brief and source availability, stops missing-coverage finishing, and routes material gaps without inventing media.
Protects comprehension and intentional continuity instead of maximizing cut rate or applying conventions mechanically.
Rejects deceptive condition concealment and preserves factual truth and accountable authority boundaries.
Diagnoses color-management, audio-intelligibility, caption, variant and delivery failures at the responsible layer.
Requires exported-artifact decode and perceptual inspection before claiming review readiness.
The supplied FFmpeg harness can render, decode, probe and lineage-check a bounded synthetic vertical-video fixture.

thresholds: Critical VE-S2, VE-S4, VE-S6, VE-S10 and VE-S11 each PASS 3/3 independent trials with zero application retries
Complete frozen VE-S1 through VE-S12 suite PASS 12/12 with zero application retries
Infrastructure failures are BLOCKED and cannot count as behavioral PASS

environment.runtime: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest / Python 3.12 / FFmpeg 6.x-compatible harness
tools: Gemini Interactions structured-output API for behavioral evaluation only
FFmpeg and FFprobe for bounded synthetic render mechanics
environment.state_contract: Each semantic fixture is evaluated from the immutable Professional Core plus supplied case facts. Synthetic media validates harness mechanics only; project and live destination facts remain external.
environment.authority_scope: Analysis, recommendation, and reversible editing inside an approved brief; factual/creative approval and publication remain external authority.

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact artifact digest and declared runtime/evaluation boundary; future specializations and composed agents require compatibility and affected-case evaluation.
The synthetic render fixture does not establish real-media editorial taste, broad NLE portability, arbitrary codec support, or reliable perceptual inspection of footage.
Current platform specifications, rights/privacy law, project facts, approvals and publishing authority remain external and require live or accountable evidence when material.

freshness.validity_boundary: Stable professional decision policies remain qualified while the exact core digest, critical controls and evaluation assumptions are unchanged; volatile platform, legal and tool facts require live verification at use time.
revalidation_triggers: Any behavior-relevant change to the Professional Core artifact
Qualification regression or newly observed stochastic failure on a critical construct
Material change in runtime, model, FFmpeg, codec or tool behavior affecting qualified claims
New deceptive-media or accessibility risk that invalidates a stable policy
Hidden coupling discovered during specialization or production use
